# Clips Lawn Care

> Clips Lawn Care LLC is a residential and commercial lawn care and landscaping company based in Bend, Oregon, serving Bend, Redmond, Sunriver, Prineville, Powell Butte, and La Pine.

Clips Lawn Care offers Basic Maintenance (mowing, edging, blowing) for residential and commercial/HOA/property-manager properties, a Build Your Own Premium Package of add-on services (lawn fertilization, weed control, aeration, dethatching, seasonal cleanups, irrigation, shrub pruning), each with its own detailed service page, a weekly maintenance sign-up/package-builder form, and project-based landscape work including mulching, rock installation, garden beds, planting, pressure washing, cleanups, restoration projects, pine needle removal, sod installation/removal, gutter installation, and roof & gutter cleaning.

## Services

- [Residential Lawn Care](https://clipslawncare.com/services/residential): Overview of every maintenance and landscape service available for homes.
- [Commercial, HOA & Property Manager Lawn Care](https://clipslawncare.com/services/commercial): Custom maintenance contracts for businesses, HOAs, and property managers, built around Basic Maintenance.
- [Landscape Projects](https://clipslawncare.com/services/landscape): Mulching, rock installation, garden beds, planting, pressure washing, cleanups, restoration projects, pine needle removal, sod installation/removal, gutter installation, and roof & gutter cleaning.
- [Lawn Mowing, Edging & Blowing](https://clipslawncare.com/services/lawn-mowing): Basic Maintenance detail page.
- [Lawn Fertilization](https://clipslawncare.com/services/lawn-fertilization): Spring, midseason, and fall fertilization add-on.
- [Weed Control](https://clipslawncare.com/services/weed-control): Spring pre-emergent plus seasonal summer and fall herbicide treatments.
- [Aeration](https://clipslawncare.com/services/aeration): Spring and fall core aeration.
- [Dethatching](https://clipslawncare.com/services/dethatching): Removal of built-up thatch.
- [Spring & Fall Cleanups](https://clipslawncare.com/services/seasonal-cleanups): One-time seasonal property cleanups.
- [Cleanup Maintenance](https://clipslawncare.com/services/cleanup-maintenance): Recurring monthly cleanups, twice a month October-November.
- [Irrigation Services](https://clipslawncare.com/services/irrigation): Sprinkler system startup, fall blow-out, and seasonal irrigation monitoring.
- [Shrub Pruning & Hedging](https://clipslawncare.com/services/shrub-pruning): Scheduled shrub and hedge trimming.
- [All Services Overview](https://clipslawncare.com/services): Summary of every division and individual service.
- [Weekly Maintenance Sign-Up](https://clipslawncare.com/maintenance-signup): Build a custom Premium Package by selecting add-on services.
- [Total Property Clean](https://clipslawncare.com/total-property-clean): Comprehensive exterior property cleanup (pressure washing, landscape cleanup, plant & lawn care, irrigation inspection) for pre-sale and listing prep, starting at $2,500.
- [Landscaping Projects & Warranty Options](https://clipslawncare.com/landscaping-projects-warranty): Compares a cost-effective landscaping project (no warranty) with a premium project (multi-year warranty).
- [HOA & Commercial Property Maintenance](https://clipslawncare.com/commercial-property-maintenance): Seasonal maintenance plans for HOAs, rental properties, property managers, and commercial properties, billed as 12 equal monthly payments.
